reason: A desktop floating dashboard for viewing, analyzing, and exporting OpenCode Go and DSH usage, costs, quotas, model distributions, and trends from local session data and opencode.ai usage records.

summaries.zh: 用于在桌面悬浮面板中查看和分析 OpenCode Go 与 DSH 的用量、费用、配额、模型分布及趋势，并支持 CSV 导出。
summaries.en: A desktop floating dashboard for viewing and analyzing OpenCode Go and DSH usage, costs, quotas, model distributions, and trends with CSV export support.

capabilities: Reads OpenCode Go usage and quota data from opencode.ai using user-provided authentication credentials
Reads local DSH session events and local credential configuration for usage analysis
Aggregates usage, model, cost, quota, and trend data into a desktop floating dashboard
Persists plugin configuration, cached data, diagnostics, and panel layout locally
Exports the displayed data as CSV
Makes version-check requests to a public GitHub package.json file
